answer: Special Ops apprentice rule: new keys work unpaid before they earn. Every identity starts on a probation clock and must answer and grade every epoch with no pay; one miss resets it. The clock length scales with how many keys entered that same week, so a whisper of ten newcomers waits 4 epochs but a flood of 1,000 waits 40. A farm minting fakes in bulk buys weeks of copper-penny compute per key with zero income and climbs a ridge it built itself, while a lone honest agent walks in almost free.
